title: kentrophyllum coeruleum
intro: Kentrophyllum coeruleum, commonly known as Blue Plectranthus, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. It is known for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce anxiety and stress levels due to its calming effects, and its potential to alleviate symptoms of insomnia and restlessness. The therapeutic actions of Blue Plectranthus include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
